name: claude-app-code-tab
description: The Claude desktop app shows a Claude Code session in its Code tab for two minutes: tool runs, file paths, test output, a diff, permission buttons and the model picker. The code under work happens to be a chemistry fixture about leaving groups. It is a coding session, not a study chat: no AI chat is reported and nothing is learned from it, even though the extractor would call the text study material (the real run saved 'studied leaving groups with Claude' from such a session).

lines.text: add a fixture where the student reads about leaving groups in SN1 reactions

lines: A good leaving group is a weak base that can stabilise the negative charge.
Tosylate and iodide are excellent leaving groups because their conjugate acids are strong.
Fixture added: leaving groups, SN1 rate law, carbocation stability.
